explanation: Almost entirely an original-phase unit (99.4% of mass at t<L; almost never on the delimiter or copy steps; never at t=0). Peaks at t=3-4. It fires on the input token, mostly 0 (34% of mass, 9x lift), then o, j, f, h, 3, r, and mostly on the first occurrence of that token. It is strongly boosted when the sequence begins with late-alphabet letters (first_tok s/t/v/u/q/w, or 1/n) and when prev2_tok is from the same group, so it depends on the context built up in the hidden state. The largest activations (0.8-1.0 of max) are on 0 or o after an s/t/v/q opening. Rarely fires on repeated tokens or on late-alphabet input tokens themselves. The predicate reaches dev F1 0.40, precision 0.30, recall 0.59, mass recall 0.69. Adding a condition on orig(1) raises precision to 0.52 but lowers recall. The exact contextual dependence was not captured, which is why the verdict is partial.
